subject: Biology
title: Human Urinary System Anatomy & Nephron Heterogeneity
learningObjectives: Identify retroperitoneal coordinates and macro-anatomical landmarks of the human kidney
Differentiate Cortical vs Juxtamedullary nephrons structurally and functionally
Understand the role of Vasa Recta in medullary architecture
content:
### 2.1 Macro-Anatomy of the Human Kidney

```
                         HUMAN KIDNEY ANATOMICAL REGIONS
                                        │
  Renal Capsule (Fibrous) ──► Cortex (Outer) ──► Medulla (Pyramids) ──► Calyces ──► Renal Pelvis ──► Ureter
```

- **Coordinates**: Retroperitoneal organs located between $\text{T}_{12}$ and $\text{L}_3$ vertebrae. Dimensions: $10\text{--}12\text{ cm}$ length, $5\text{--}7\text{ cm}$ width, $2\text{--}3\text{ cm}$ thickness, weight $120\text{--}170\text{ g}$.
- **Internal Zonation**:
  - **Renal Cortex**: Outer granular layer extending between medullary pyramids as **Columns of Bertini**.
  - **Renal Medulla**: Divided into 8–18 conical Medullary Pyramids terminating in renal papillae, draining into Minor and Major Calyces $\rightarrow$ **Renal Pelvis** $\rightarrow$ Ureter.

### 2.2 Cortical vs Juxtamedullary Nephron Heterogeneity

```
                     CORTICAL vs JUXTAMEDULLARY NEPHRONS
                     
   CORTICAL NEPHRONS (85% of total):
   ├── Glomerulus situated in outer renal cortex.
   ├── Short Loop of Henle extending only slightly into medulla.
   └── Vasa Recta is reduced or COMPLETELY ABSENT.
   
   JUXTAMEDULLARY NEPHRONS (15% of total):
   ├── Glomerulus situated deep near the corticomedullary junction.
   ├── Long Loop of Henle extending deep into the inner medulla.
   └── Well-developed Vasa Recta operating parallel to Henle's loop.
   └── ESSENTIAL FOR CONCENTRATING URINE (Counter-Current Mechanism)!
```

- **Cortical Nephrons ($85\%$)**: High abundance, short Henle loops, low Vasa Recta presence, primarily perform bulk filtration and basic reabsorption.
- **Juxtamedullary Nephrons ($15\%$)**: Deep corticomedullary position, long hairpin loops extending to papillae, richly wrapped by hairpin Vasa Recta loops that establish hyperosmolar medullary gradients.

conceptBreakdown.heading: Columns of Bertini
conceptBreakdown.explanation: Inward extensions of cortical tissue that project between adjacent medullary pyramids, housing interlobar arteries and veins that supply the renal parenchyma.

conceptBreakdown.heading: Functional Significance of Juxtamedullary Nephrons
conceptBreakdown.explanation: Although comprising only 15% of the nephron pool, juxtamedullary nephrons are solely responsible for generating the 1200 mOsmol/L hyperosmotic gradient required to concentrate urine during water deprivation.
